formula.indices: f = 0 for P (row18_dev_p_def), 1 for Q (row18_dev_q_def); k = position of the index in the defining row own iteration order, 0..N-1, N = n T
formula.target_e: sign * (EMU_MAG_BASE + EMU_MAG_STEP * ((2 b + f) N + k)), sign = -1 iff (k + f + b) % EMU_NEG_EVERY == 0, else +1
formula.expectation: expected_interface_pf_{p,q}[t] = a_f + c_f * t_ordinal + d_f * b, (a_f, c_f, d_f) = EMU_EXPECTATION[f]
formula.flow: the reference generator's pg (P) / qg (Q) [network.get_reference_gen_idx(), s_m, s_o, t] is shifted so value(pg_adn|qg_adn) - value(expectation) == target; the achieved e is read back from the model per index and must equal the target within TOL_EMULATION_ABS (a wrong Var or coefficient fails here)
formula.not_done: bounds are not respected, no other Var is touched, nothing is solved

|value(body) - value(upper)| <= TOL_BODY_ABS for the defining row, the body evaluated by Pyomo FROM THE MODEL, not from the recomputed e -- this cross-validates the family table against the actual rows (v2 required == 0.0 exactly; amended to a declared tolerance per the W57 task; whether it is exactly 0.0 is recorded, not predicted)

the emulation achieved every target within TOL_EMULATION_ABS
